title: Continual Safety Alignment via Gradient-Based Sample Selection
authors_zh: Thong Bach, Dung Nguyen, Thao Minh Le, Truyen Tran
paper_type_zh: 基于梯度的持续微调数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合把已对齐模型迁移到良性领域、又不希望额外加入安全回放集的读者。
one_line: The paper preserves continual safety alignment by excluding high-gradient task records and training on moderate-gradient examples instead.
该研究通过排除高梯度任务记录、保留中等梯度样本，在持续微调中缓解安全对齐漂移。
why: It shows that even benign records have unequal alignment cost and makes that cost a direct training-selection criterion.
inclusion_reason: It selects which benign fine-tuning records are allowed to update an aligned model, explicitly using gradient magnitude to control the safety-versus-task optimization trade-off.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Benign continual fine-tuning can weaken refusal, truthfulness, and other alignment behaviors. The paper argues that drift is not caused equally by all task records: some examples create updates that pull the aligned model back toward pretrained behavior.

It asks which records should be withheld so a model can learn a new task without leaving its safety basin. The target is a data-level intervention, not a new safety dataset or architecture.

即使是良性的持续微调，也会削弱拒答、真实性和其他对齐行为。论文认为并非所有任务记录都会同等造成漂移：部分样本会产生把已对齐模型拉回预训练行为的更新。

它要回答的是，应暂缓哪些记录，才能让模型学习新任务而不离开安全盆地。目标是数据层面的干预，而不是新安全数据集或新架构。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper uses per-sample gradient magnitude as a signal of alignment tension. High-gradient records tend to produce larger drift, while moderate-gradient records can still support task learning with smaller safety loss.

The selection rule therefore avoids both indiscriminate full-data training and a low-gradient-only subset. It prefilters loss outliers and chooses examples nearest the median gradient magnitude.

论文把单样本梯度大小作为对齐张力的信号。高梯度记录往往造成更大的漂移，而中等梯度记录仍能支持任务学习，并带来更小的安全损失。

因此选择规则既不无差别地使用全数据，也不只保留低梯度子集。它先过滤损失离群点，再选择最接近梯度中位数的例子。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each task record, the aligned starting model computes supervised loss and its gradient norm. Loss outliers are removed first, then records are ranked by distance from the median gradient norm.

The retained moderate-gradient fraction is fine-tuned sequentially for each continual task. The paper uses a 0.2 fraction by default and tests 0.1–0.4, evaluating both task learning and safety attacks.

对每条任务记录，已对齐的起始模型计算监督损失及其梯度范数。先移除损失离群点，再按与梯度中位数的距离排序记录。

每个持续任务只在保留下来的中等梯度比例上顺序微调。论文默认比例为 0.2，并测试 0.1–0.4，同时评估任务学习与安全攻击。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper compares low-, moderate-, and high-gradient selections, full-data fine-tuning, clipping, and related baselines across several model families and task orders. It measures attack success and safety-basin preservation alongside task performance.

The authors report that moderate-gradient selection preserves 83–88 percent of alignment in their reported setting and is robust across tested selection ratios. The evidence is empirical and task-specific, not a formal guarantee for arbitrary safety policies.

论文比较低、中、高梯度选择、全数据微调、梯度裁剪及相关基线，覆盖多个模型族和任务顺序。它同时测量攻击成功率、安全盆地保持情况和任务性能。

作者报告，在其设置中中等梯度选择可保持 83–88% 的对齐，并且在所测选择比例中稳健。证据是经验性且依赖任务的，并非对任意安全策略的正式保证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is a direct link between a record's gradient magnitude and its alignment cost during continual adaptation. Selection is aimed at preserving a safety basin, not merely reducing loss or maximizing task difficulty.

Moderate gradients become the intended training surface: they retain learnable task signal while avoiding the elastic reversion associated with the highest-gradient records.

新意在于直接把一条记录的梯度大小与持续适应中的对齐成本相连。选择目标不是只降低损失或最大化任务难度，而是保持安全盆地。

中等梯度成为预期训练表面：它保留可学习的任务信号，同时避开最高梯度记录关联的弹性回退。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method adds per-sample gradient computation and is evaluated on particular model families, task streams, and safety benchmarks. It may trade away examples needed for a specialized task, and it does not replace a broader safety audit. The paper declares no official code or selected-data release.
该方法增加了逐样本梯度计算，并只在特定模型族、任务流和安全基准上评估。它可能舍弃某个专门任务所需的例子，也不能取代更广泛的安全审计。论文没有声明官方代码或所选数据发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this as a recipe when benign domain adaptation threatens an aligned model and a task dataset can be scored before training. It is most useful for setting an explicit safety-task trade-off at the record-selection layer; evaluate the chosen ratio with the deployment's own safety tests.
当良性领域适应也会威胁已对齐模型，且任务数据可在训练前评分时，可把本文作为配方。它最适合在记录选择层明确设置安全与任务的权衡；应使用部署场景自己的安全测试评估所选比例。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the result as evidence that training records have unequal safety cost. Check the loss outlier prefilter, the median-gradient rule, and the attack metrics together; a lower attack success rate is meaningful only if task performance and the target domain remain acceptable.
应把结果理解为训练记录具有不相等的安全成本。请一起检查损失离群预过滤、梯度中位数规则和攻击指标；只有任务性能与目标领域仍可接受时，更低的攻击成功率才有意义。
